ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: Tile Features
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
VEE_FLORA_VENTS_BUILD_XML_FIRST (design/RimMandrake/vee_port_plan_2026-10-22.md, groups F, W and V): world-tile features ported from Vanilla Exploration Expanded into our own defs, so that mod can be retired.
Flora: wild cacti, red desert cacti, light-resistant mushrooms, overgrown and decimated plant life, no trees, poisonous flora, reduced soil fertility, marine sanctuaries and crashed mechanoid ship chunks. Weather and conditions: sandstorms, dust storms, a permanent rotten stench, more diseases and more infestations. Vents: toxic, rotstink and smoke geysers that vent gas on a cycle.
These features are never placed on the world by this mod (no worldgen): they act only on tiles that already carry them.
Every group has its own Mod Settings switch; all off gives plain maps. Uses the Vanilla Expanded Framework and every DLC.
